newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BIDDERS FOR SHIPPING FIRM READY FOR FIGHT.
newsitem.headline: BIDDERS FOR SHIPPING FIRM READY FOR FIGHT.

text.p: The three bidders chosen to make an offer for Estonian Shipping said on Wednesday they were ready for a tough competition to buy 70 percent of the company.
The bidders chosen earlier by the Estonian Privatisation Agency were Arbonale, a consortium of Jinhui Shipping and Transport Ltd, Nomura, Hansa Investments and Norwegian shipping group Marsoft.
The other bidders are Baltic Cresco and Esco Holdings.
The consortia represent interests from Japan, Hong Kong, the United States and Sweden as well as local investors.
"Our chances are very good. We have an excellent team of international and local and strategic partners," said Toomas Reisenbuk, executive director of Hansa Investments.
Baltic Cresco is an investment banking firm which is two years old and has four private partners. It also has two backers, one from Estonia and one from the U.S.
"Cresco has something to offer and we are bidding to win," a representative of the firm said.
Toivo Ninnas, a representative of Esco, said he had not yet been officially notified of being chosen as a bidder and said he was interested in seeing the conditions for the next round.
Esco group was formed by Swedish Carnegie AB and local group, Esco Holdings.
